true finding|divination.synergy: Locates any named creature, object, or place in the world; cornerstone of investigation or search-and-rescue scenarios.

true love|enchantment.synergy: Permanently charm a powerful NPC as a loyal asset; keep them in proximity or they degrade and die, making presence management a core build constraint.

true nature|divination.synergy: Reveals enemy stat block and a key vulnerability mid-encounter, letting the whole group exploit the information immediately.

true protection|protection.synergy: Month-long near-invulnerability on a key frontliner; the cannot-die clause lets tanks absorb impossible punishment indefinitely.

truth ear|divination.synergy: Passive truth-detection for a full hour; layer with social talents to lock down interrogation and negotiation scenes with guaranteed lie-detection.

tsunami|water.synergy: Coastal/naval wipe spell; aftereffect deals up to 10d6 to the caster, so pair with damage mitigation or use when near-death is acceptable.

tumescent puffballs|nature.synergy: Forced movement into puffball zones stacks heavy obscurement with poison for layered multi-round area denial.

twain self|time.synergy: Doubles your turns for 1 minute; most powerful with high-damage builds, but shared damage and afflictions mean any hit is twice as punishing.

twisted crown|fey.synergy: Position a melee tank beside the caster to exploit stunned enemies each round; concentrate again each turn to stun any new creatures that close the range.

twisted words|curse.synergy: Forces target to lie for 1 minute; shuts down verbal command coordination and is devastating in social or interrogation encounters.

ultimate security|protection.synergy: Ritual-cast before defenders arrive to layer fog, sleep traps, and summoned monsters into a near-impenetrable layered defense.

unassailable mind|telepathy.synergy: Near-immunity to mental attacks for 1 minute; condition immunity lets the caster press offensive Telepathy spells without fear of interruption.

unchained probabilities|chaos.synergy: Stack enemy banes and ally boons before casting; odd d6 exploits banes, even d6 exploits boons, biasing all outcomes toward your side.

undead legion|necromancy.synergy: The Sacrifice cast tops all undead HP at once; pair with undead buffs or auras to amplify the army's combat power.

undead plague|necromancy.synergy: Creates a self-sustaining undead army from any corpse in a 10-mile zone; aftereffect punishes all but the most powerful necromancers.

underwater adaptation|alteration.synergy: Lets a melee combatant fight at full Speed underwater without contested swim rolls; essential prep for any aquatic dungeon segment.

underworld screams|death.synergy: Place in a chokepoint and let every ally hit deal 2d6 bonus damage; stacks with burst-damage builds to massively spike zone output.

underworld|spiritualism.synergy: Anchor within medium range for 2-boon Spiritualism attacks and a free triggered-action cast each turn while enemies suffer Insanity and fear.

underworld’s gates|spiritualism.synergy: Opens a 1-hour portal that spawns random Underworld creatures each minute and strips Insanity from every mortal in sight; devastating in confined spaces.

undo constitution|death.synergy: 2 banes on all Strength attack and challenge rolls for 1 minute; synergizes with any spell or attack that forces Strength saves.

undo reality|chaos.synergy: Rank 10 battlefield annihilator; high-Will builds invest in survivability to survive the self-risk failure penalty.

unerring darts|arcana.synergy: Guaranteed 7 damage split freely among targets; reliable finisher on multiple wounded enemies with no attack roll needed.

unfailing tracker|technomancy.synergy: Denies hidden status from a tracked target for 1 hour; ideal for assassins or hunters who must guarantee first-strike positioning.

unhinge the mind|telepathy.synergy: High Will targets suffer most; follow with Rend Mind to guarantee frightened and spellcasting denial.

unholy chorus|demonology.synergy: Stunned singing creatures create a self-perpetuating Insanity aura; chain with additional Insanity spells to cascade madness through groups.

universal solvent|alchemy.synergy: Pre-crafted acid weapon; instantly kills restrained/stunned targets without a save, enabling burst damage against controlled enemies.

unleash bone machine|necromancy.synergy: Sacrifice option mass-heals all compelled undead in range, making this the cornerstone of a sustained undead army build.

unlife|death.synergy: Death mages activate pre-combat for condition immunity, invisibility to undead, and 1 boon on Death attack rolls while enemies resist at 1 bane.

unlight|madness.synergy: Counters invisibility and illusions for up to 10 allies; fumbled rolls carry group Insanity risk that includes the caster.

unlikely transformation|chaos.synergy: Impaired+frightened target spreads fear to nearby creatures; a crit transforms the target into a harmless animal for 1 minute.

unlock potential|alteration.synergy: Cast as triggered action on your turn to give a martial ally boons on attacks and saves for a crucial round; full 2-boon version rewards normal-action use.

unmake|death.synergy: Instant-kill potential on any target; aftereffect demands Strength investment or aftereffect mitigation to cast safely.

unreasoning hatred|enchantment.synergy: Redirect a high-damage enemy to attack your tankiest ally; retarget as a free triggered action to keep the compelled creature wasting attacks.

unruly organs|forbidden.synergy: Escalating 2d6/round with 1-bane Strength saves; incapacitation spawns hostile monsters, rewarding debuffers that lock down Strength-weak targets.

unspeakable graft|forbidden.synergy: Grants special traits like claws or darkvision to allies; melee builds benefit most from offensive natural weapons or sensory upgrades.

untouchable object|protection.synergy: Prevents physical seizure of a spell focus, key, or quest item for 1 hour — reliable defense against theft-based encounters.

uplifting melody|song.synergy: Delivers 2 boons to any roll once per round; best paired with allies making single high-impact attacks or contested challenges.

uplifting step|air.synergy: Skirmishers ignore terrain and gaps to maintain optimal position; combine with reach weapons for no-penalty approach.

utter ruin|forbidden.synergy: On madness proc the target self-inflicts damage equal to its Health; most devastating against high-HP targets with low Will saves.

vacuum|air.synergy: Two-phase AoE knocks enemies prone and pulls them into a zone, setting up boon-fueled follow-up attacks.

venomous dart|alchemy.synergy: Pre-combat crafting grants poison darts with boon on attack rolls; effective for distributing to the whole party.

venomous fangs|primal.synergy: Cast and immediately bite on the same turn; follow-up attacks compound poison damage while the target remains poisoned.

venomous shape|transformation.synergy: Passive poison on all animal-form attacks; Sacrifice converts this casting into flowing form for flexible mid-fight repositioning.

vertigo|illusion.synergy: Neutralizes mobile enemies; the 20+ prone-on-damage trigger stacks with melee allies who gain boons attacking prone targets.

vexing spirit|spiritualism.synergy: Frightens the target and repositions it on each failed roll; combines with AoE setups or hazards to punish the forced moves.

vigilance|protection.synergy: Blocks charm, compel, fear, surprise, and sleep magic on one ally for 4 hours — essential counter to crowd-control heavy enemies.

vigor|protection.synergy: Cheaply extends a frontliner's effective HP for a full encounter; stacks with other healing to reduce the risk of going down.

vision of nowhere|demonology.synergy: Best used on targets already near their Insanity threshold; triggering madness incapacitation kills the target and destroys its soul.

vision|divination.synergy: Strips all concealment, invisibility, and magical disguise from the environment; pairs with infiltrators or controllers who rely on detecting hidden threats.

vision’s end|forbidden.synergy: Blind a key threat while per-round Strength challenge rolls chip HP; three failures make blindness permanent, hard-countering melee or ranged attackers.

vitality burst|life.synergy: Group heal that restores each target's full healing rate simultaneously; most efficient immediately after area-damage rounds with multiple injured allies.

vivisection|forbidden.synergy: Use after debuffers drop target HP near incapacitation; the kill triggers a Will challenge imposing 1 Insanity on all witnesses as a free area-denial bonus.

voice of thunder|song.synergy: Funnel enemies into a corridor to maximize cone overlap; forced knockback and deafening disrupts formations and separates enemies.

voice of ultimate authority|order.synergy: Auto-compels any creature with Will ≤15 for the rest of the encounter; pair with Will-reducing debuffs to threshold high-Will targets into auto-compel range.

void tentacles|shadow.synergy: Cluster enemies before casting; each concentration auto-fails already-grabbed targets and adds escalating choke damage.

voracious earth|earth.synergy: Per-round area damage rewards keeping enemies in zone; pairs with immobilize or prone effects to prevent escape.

vulnerability|curse.synergy: Grants the whole party 1 boon on attacks and imposes 1 bane on target's resistance rolls; ideal opener before a coordinated focus-fire burst round.

waking nightmare|illusion.synergy: Stacks 1d3 Insanity per round; combine with other Insanity sources to push the target past the madness threshold before it accumulates enough banes to shut the nightmare down.

wall of darkness|shadow.synergy: Blocks line of sight in corridors or flanking approaches; stack with darksight buffs so only your side sees through it.

wall of flames|fire.synergy: Persistent fire wall channels and punishes movement; combine with push or forced-movement effects to send enemies through it.

wall of gears|technomancy.synergy: Bisects the battlefield with a damage zone; forced-movement spells drive enemies into the wall for compounding damage each round.

wall of ice|water.synergy: Immobilizes clustered enemies in place and zones the battlefield; ranged or blaster allies freely punish locked-down targets each round.

wall of runes|rune.synergy: Immobilizes creatures crossing the line; lets ranged allies punish trapped enemies with no safe exit.

wall of stone|earth.synergy: Permanent terrain reshaping; use to seal passages, create bridges, or split the battlefield before or during encounters.

wall of swords|battle.synergy: Splits the battlefield with a persistent damage zone for 1 hour; push enemies into it with forced-movement effects for maximum attrition.

warden of the underworld|death.synergy: Reposition the figure each turn via triggered action to chain fear checks and deal damage, creating persistent zone denial.

warding buckler|metal.synergy: Sustained mode gives persistent 1-bane on weapon attacks; triggered mode spikes to 3 banes on one critical incoming attack.

warp flesh|alteration.synergy: Low-rank attack usable across most traditions; impaired-on-20+ rewards boon sources and chains into debuff builds.

watchful eyes|technomancy.synergy: Cover chokepoints with sensors; deafening blast disrupts enemy coordination and the shriek alerts you from up to 1 mile away.

water burst|water.synergy: Challenge-roll-for-prone on all nearby creatures enables melee follow-up; pairs with cold or area debuff spells for stacked crowd control.

watery form|water.synergy: Halves all incoming damage and boosts Strength/Agility rolls; ideal for melee Water casters who benefit from the +1d6 Water spell damage bonus.

watery serpent|water.synergy: Persistent per-round immobilization lets melee allies freely engage; reposition the serpent each round to lock down the highest-priority target.

wave|water.synergy: Form the wall for cover on round 1, then crash it into clustered enemies for prone plus damage to enable follow-up strikes.

weakness|curse.synergy: Stacks –10 Health with Strength/Agility banes; neuters melee warriors and synergizes with blaster damage that benefits from reduced enemy Health.

weapon appendage|transformation.synergy: Lets Will-based casters use their primary stat for finesse melee attacks; immediate attack on cast rewards aggressive action-economy plays.

wee free men|fey.synergy: Repeating damage plus impaired punishes clustered foes each round; sustain while allies focus-fire weakest targets to maximize efficiency.

weight of years|death.synergy: Aging a creature into the corpse category kills it outright; even partial aging deals Health-score damage on a failed Strength roll.

well of dark power|necromancy.synergy: Every damage source in the zone deals +2d6 for 1 minute; combine with area damage spells and multi-attack allies for cascading output.

well of magic|arcana.synergy: Station all party spellcasters inside the zone to simultaneously gain 2 attack boons and impose 2 save banes on every attack spell cast from within it.

wellspring of life|water.synergy: Position your dedicated healer inside the well; every heal they cast gains +1d3, compounding sharply with burst AoE heals.

whirlwind of death|battle.synergy: Twin AoE melee sweeps with mid-cast flight repositioning; pairs with mobility buffs to maximize reach on both sweep instances.

wild magic|chaos.synergy: Use as a wildcard when the fight is static; the d20 table can shift momentum drastically in either direction.

wildfire|fire.synergy: Moveable fire cube for zone denial; combo with push or pull effects to sweep enemies through the flames each round.

will-o’-wisp|fey.synergy: Herd beguiled enemies toward a hazard by moving the flame each turn; pair with area damage placed at the flame's destination.

wind blast|air.synergy: Forced movement repositions foes; prone on a 20+ attack roll grants adjacent melee allies attack boons against the target.

wind disk|air.synergy: Defense boost plus bane on ranged attackers; Shield Disk extends protection to nearby allies, making it ideal for front-line defenders.

wipe the mind|telepathy.synergy: Completely nullifies a spellcaster or leader for an hour; direct the victim into hazards or away from your party.

witch fire|witch.synergy: Invisibility enables safe repeated attacks each round; position the ball before the effect ends to teleport into an ideal flanking spot.

world-breaker bomb|technomancy.synergy: One-shot ritual nuke requiring 1-hour setup; position all allies outside the blast radius before triggering to avoid catastrophic friendly fire.

wrath of god|theurgy.synergy: AOE lightning dazes all who fail their save; best with controllers who cluster enemies to maximize simultaneous hits.

wrath of nature|nature.synergy: Immobilized targets grant adjacent melee allies boons; pair with follow-up burst damage or zone-denial to lock down groups.

written in blood|demonology.synergy: Pre-combat self-buff: 2 boons on your resistance rolls and 2 banes on enemy attack rolls at the cost of 1 damage and a –5 Health penalty.

wyvern form|transformation.synergy: Large flying combat form for 1 hour; complements any party buff that boosts the caster's attack rolls in beast form.

zeal|enchantment.synergy: Supercharges uninjured allies with 3-boon attacks and +2d6 damage; best on durable front-liners who avoid taking the first hit.
